lines.text: Isaiah son of Amoz receives a burden against Babylon, and the LORD of Hosts mobilizes an army from faraway lands.
The Day of the LORD is near, every heart will melt, and people will writhe like a woman in labor.
The stars and the sun will be darkened, and the LORD will make man rarer than the gold of Sheba.
Each person will flee to his own people, and the LORD will stir up the Persians against them.
Babylon will be overthrown by God like Sodom and Gomorrah, and hyenas will howl in her fortresses.
